en: Can you remember on which day God created humans? How were they created? The Chinese translation of “greed” is 婪. Do you notice any connection between the structure of the word “婪” (two trees and one woman) and the origin of sin?
zh: 讀完後能否記住，神是第幾天造人，如何造的？ 是否發現這個字“婪”和罪的由來有關聯?

en: Did anyone in the genealogies in chapter 5 get drowned by the flood? The Chinese translation of “ark” is 船. Does the structure of the word “船” (one boat and eight people) suggest a deeper meaning to you?
zh: 第五章家譜裡的人有沒有被洪水淹死的？ 你對這個字“船”有了更多的理解嗎？

en: What covenant did God make with Noah and his descendants, including you and me? When Babel is being translated from Hebrew into English, what is it also called? Or, to put it another way, there is a city in the Bible whose name comes from the same Hebrew word as Babel. Which city is it?
zh: 神和諾亞及後裔，包括你和我立了什麼約？ 巴別，從希伯來文翻譯成中文也稱作什麼，或者說聖經裡有一個城市的名字和巴別是同一個希伯來字，它是哪個城市？

en: What covenant did God make with Abram? Who came out to meet Abram with bread and wine?
zh: 神和亞伯蘭立了什麼約？ 誰拿酒和餅迎接亞伯蘭？

en: What new names did God give to Abram and Sarai, and what do they mean? Why did God destroy Sodom and Gomorrah?
zh: 神給亞伯蘭和撒萊的新名字叫什麼，有什麼含義？ 神為什麼要毀滅所多瑪和蛾摩拉？

en: How old was Abram when he left Haran? How old was he when Isaac was born? What does Jehovah-jireh mean? Was Isaac’s wife a Canaanite?
zh: 亞伯蘭出哈蘭時多大年齡？ 生以撒時多大年齡？ 耶和華以勒是什麼意思？ 以撒的妻子是迦南人嗎？

en: Why was Esau also called Edom? Comparing Genesis 26:7 with Genesis 26:16 and 26:28–29, what do you observe? When Jacob deceived Isaac to receive the blessing, what methods did Isaac use to determine whether he was really Esau? What does Bethel mean?
zh: 以掃為什麼又叫以東？ 對照創世記 26:7 與 26:16、26:28–29，你讀出了什麼？ 當雅各騙以撒要祝福時，以撒用哪些方法來確定他是不是以掃？ 伯特利是什麼意思？

en: Jacob deceived his father, who then deceived Jacob? How many years did Jacob serve Laban? Why was Jacob also called Israel?
zh: 雅各騙了父親，那誰騙了他？ 雅各服侍拉班多少年？ 雅各又被稱為以色列，為什麼？

en: Where did Jacob tell Esau he was going? But where did he actually go instead? How many sons did Jacob have? After Isaac died, where did Jacob live? Where did Esau live?
zh: 雅各對以掃說他會去什麼地方？ 但他實際卻去了另外什麼地方？ 雅各有多少個兒子？ 以撒死後，雅各住在哪裡？ 以掃住在哪裡？

en: For how much silver was Joseph sold by his brothers? After he was sold, who was with him so that everything he did prospered? Did Joseph refuse Potiphar’s wife because he was afraid of offending his master? At this time, Judah slept with someone he should not have—who was she? From whom did Joseph’s ability to interpret dreams come?
zh: 約瑟被哥哥們賣了多少銀子？ 被賣之後，誰與他同在，使他百事順利？ 約瑟不從波提乏妻子的誘惑，是因為他怕得罪他的主人嗎？ 此時猶大卻和一個他不應該同寢的人同寢，她是誰？ 約瑟解夢的能力出於誰？

en: How old was Joseph when he governed the whole land of Egypt? When they first went to Egypt to buy grain, how many sons did Jacob send? Whom did Joseph keep in custody while the other brothers returned to bring their youngest brother? In whose bag was the lost cup found? Who was willing to become Joseph’s slave in place of another?
zh: 約瑟治理埃及全地時多大年齡？ 第一次到埃及買糧時，雅各派了幾個兒子？ 約瑟把誰囚下，讓其餘的哥哥回去把他們的小弟弟帶來？ 失落的杯是在誰的袋子裡被發現的？ 是誰願意代替他人做約瑟的奴僕？

en: Who do you think sent Joseph to Egypt? Who would go down to Egypt with Jacob and surely bring him back up again? How many people from Jacob’s family came to Egypt in total? How old was Jacob when he went down to Egypt? How many years did Jacob live? Which of Jacob’s sons received a double portion?
zh: 你認為是誰差約瑟去了埃及？ 誰要和雅各一同下埃及去，也必定帶他上來？ 雅各家來到埃及的共有多少人？ 雅各下埃及時多大年齡？ 雅各平生的年日是多少？ 雅各兒子中誰多得一份？

en: Which son received the greatest blessing from Jacob? After Jacob died, was he buried in Egypt? After his father’s death, did Joseph intend to repay his brothers for their evil deeds? Before his death, how did Joseph ask the Israelites to deal with his bones?
zh: 雅各給哪個兒子的祝福最好？ 雅各死後是葬在埃及嗎？ 約瑟在父親死後是否要報復他哥哥們的惡行？ 約瑟臨死前要以色列的子孫如何處理他的骸骨？
